# Orders
Owns customer orders and GET /orders.

# reporting
Builds a daily document from orders.
files.reporting/export.py:
import requests

ORDERS_URL = "https://orders.test"


def export_day(day):
    response = requests.get(ORDERS_URL + "/orders", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]
